name: Kozilek's Command
notes: The ability's text is the 'Choose two' line alone: a modal bullet is not a line of its own (README, Claiming lines), and naming all four bullets would put the ability over its budget - a choose-mode counts once per substantive mode, so four modes cannot pay for five named lines. The Spawn token's 'Sacrifice this token: Add {C}.' is the token op's spawn flag; name 'Eldrazi Spawn' is the printed token name (CR 111.4). ENGINE DEFECT, reported rather than worked around: mode 3's filter mvLE: 'X' is the card's X, but characteristics.ts:260 evaluates a non-numeric mvLE with the item's X hard-coded to 0, so the mode is currently offered only against mana-value-0 creatures. Writing a number there would be a different card, so the correct amount stays. Lint workaround: the token's count is written as {sum:['X']} and the graveyard-card target carries an empty filter, because src/cards/lint.ts rejects a literal count of 'X' as an 'unknown amount count' unless a sibling filter is present.

issues: • Exile target creature with mana value X or less. — expected Exiles any creature whose mana value is <= the X paid for this spell. — scripted exile target {kind:'creature', filter:{mvLE:'X'}} — the correct expression, but characteristics.ts:274 evaluates a non-numeric mvLE as evalAmount(s, f.mvLE, ctrl, 0, source) with the x argument hard-coded to 0, so in play the mode is only offered against mana-value-0 creatures. CONFIRMED ENGINE DEFECT (the blind run reproduces it: mv-2 creature with X=2 not castable). No script-side spelling avoids it — every X form routes through the same x=0 call — so I do not count it against the script, but the card is functionally broken until the engine is fixed and no openNeeds entry records it ([] in the batch). — CR CR 202.3b, 601.2c

• Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." — expected The TARGET PLAYER creates them; 0/1, colorless, Creature — Eldrazi Spawn, with the sacrifice-for-{C} ability. — scripted scoped who:'target-player' around token {count:{sum:['X']}, 0/1, colors:[], types:['Creature'], subtypes:['Eldrazi','Spawn'], name:'Eldrazi Spawn', spawn:true}. Correct: game.ts:1648 sets item.actor and game.ts:1062 reads p = item.actor ?? item.controller, so the tokens are the target player's; the spawn flag is the built-in mana ability (ops/_tokens.ts Spawn). The blind naming failure is the harness's findByName reading def.name, not the script. — CR CR 111.4

• Target player scries X, then draws a card. — expected The same target player scries X and draws. — scripted scoped who:'target-player' [scry X, draw 1 who:'you'] — 'you' inside a scoped block resolves to item.actor, i.e. the target player, so the draw does not leak to the caster. Correct.

• Exile up to X target cards from graveyards. — expected Any player's graveyard, up to X targets. — scripted exile target {kind:'graveyard-card', count:'X', optional:true, filter:{}}; legal.ts:153 scans every player's graveyard when the spec has no `who`, and specCount (legal.ts:58) resolves 'X' to the item's X. Correct.

Choose two — — expected Two DIFFERENT modes, applied in printed order. — scripted choose-mode count 2; modeCombos (legal.ts:417) emits only i<j pairs and game.ts:890 expands them ascending. Correct. — CR CR 601.2b, 700.2c

Exile target creature with mana value X or less. — expected With X=2 on the stack, any creature of mana value 2 or less is a legal target. — scripted exile target {kind:'creature', filter:{mvLE:'X'}}. characteristics.ts:274 resolves a non-numeric mvLE through evalAmount(..., x=0, ...) (line 150-152: 'X' returns the x argument, hard-coded 0 here), so the filter always reads 'mana value 0 or less'. The mode is offered only against mv-0 creatures and cannot be cast at a Grizzly Bears with X=2 - the blind scenario confirms. The fault is engine-side, but the card as scripted does not play correctly. — CR CR 202.3b / 601.2c

Target player creates X 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens with "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." — expected The targeted player creates the tokens; each is 0/1, colorless, Eldrazi Spawn, with the sac-for-{C} mana ability. — scripted scoped who 'target-player' around token {count:{sum:['X']}, 0/1, colors:[], subtypes:['Eldrazi','Spawn'], name:'Eldrazi Spawn', spawn:true}. scoped rebinds item.actor (game.ts:1648) and the token op uses p = actor (game.ts:1062,1377), so the target player gets them; mana.ts:32 gives a spawn token the ['C'] option and game.ts:914 sacrifices it. Correct. — CR CR 111.4 / 605.1a

Target player scries X, then draws a card. — expected Both the scry and the draw belong to the targeted player, not the caster. — scripted scoped who 'target-player' do [scry X, draw 1 who 'you']. Inside the scope 'you' resolves to item.actor, so the targeted player scries and draws. Correct despite the who:'you' spelling. — CR CR 701.17a

Exile up to X target cards from graveyards. — expected Up to X targets, drawn from ANY player's graveyard. — scripted exile target {kind:'graveyard-card', count:'X', optional:true, filter:{}} with from:'graveyard'. legal.ts:153 omits the who restriction, so all graveyards are eligible, and specCount (legal.ts:58,359) resolves 'X' from the cast's chosen X. Correct. — CR CR 406.2 / 115.1
Choose two - — expected Two DIFFERENT modes, chosen on cast. — scripted choose-mode count 2; modeCombos (legal.ts:417) enumerates unordered distinct pairs only. Correct. — CR CR 700.2d
